prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 12 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Garden of the wedding venue, Day, bright sunny garden light.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 4: the character sheet of Officiant (58)
Image 5: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 6: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 7: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 8: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Image 9: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 10: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 11: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 12: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 13: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 14: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 15: the prop wedding-gift box; use only structure, material, and color
Image 16: the prop bouquet; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Camera on the aisle in front of the white wooden wedding arch, on the rose-bush side. Natalie, in her ivory bridal gown and short veil, stands under the centre of the arch, holding the one bouquet loosely at her waist and staring at Sebastian. Sebastian, in his black tuxedo, stands beside her under the arch on the boxwood-hedge side, facing her. George, in his charcoal suit, stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, facing down the aisle. The Officiant stands at the centre of the arch just behind the couple, hands clasped, facing down the aisle. Cassie, in her scarlet satin cocktail dress, stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, holding the one empty white gift box with its lid off. Lauren, in her lilac sheath dress with a small handbag on her arm, stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side. Two short rows of white folding chairs flank the petal aisle. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. On the boxwood-hedge side of the lawn stands one small round white high cocktail table with one silver tray; Guest 1 stands at it on the arch side and Guest 2 on the aisle side, each holding a champagne flute, and Guest 1's pink phone is in the silver clutch under her arm.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in from the aisle toward the arch, eye-level, from the rose-bush side. Natalie, bouquet at her waist, faces Sebastian under the flower-hung arch, with George beside her on the rose-bush side and the Officiant behind them. Cassie, a step in front of Natalie, tips the empty white gift box toward her with a smirk; Lauren stands against the front-row chair on the hedge side, and Guest 1 and Guest 2 watch from the cocktail table by the hedge with their flutes.
Panel 2: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Lauren, leaning against the front-row chair on the hedge side, looks Natalie up and down and arches a brow; behind her, out of focus, Guest 1 and Guest 2 stand at the cocktail table with their flutes.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, clean single framed tight on face and shoulders, locked-off camera, eye-level. Natalie, under the arch, turns her head toward Lauren and holds her stepmother's eyes with a level, cold gaze.
Panel 4: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Natalie's shoulder, eye-level. Sebastian, on the hedge side of the arch, leans slightly toward Natalie with a lazy, amused half-smile, the back of Natalie's veil in the foreground.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Sebastian's shoulder at one frame edge and George's arm at the other. Natalie, bouquet still at her waist, looks up at Sebastian and a small smile breaks across her face.
Panel 6: Medium shot, slight low angle, locked-off camera, the arch drapes framing him. The Officiant, hands clasped, looks from Natalie to Sebastian; their shoulders show at both frame edges.
Panel 7: Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level. Natalie lifts her chin and gives a firm nod, her eyes steady.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, clean single, slow push in on Sebastian, eye-level. Sebastian glances past Natalie toward Cassie and Lauren at the head of the aisle, then back at her with a sly grin.
Panel 9: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the aisle on the rose-bush side. The Officiant opens his clasped hands toward the couple, with Natalie and Sebastian at the frame edges.
Panel 10: Medium shot, three-shot under the arch, handheld camera, eye-level. Sebastian offers Natalie his open hand. Natalie pushes the bouquet into George's hands beside her, ignores Sebastian's hand, grabs his satin lapels and pulls him close.
Panel 11: Close-up, slow orbit around the couple on the aisle side, starting on Natalie's profile and ending on Sebastian's, eye-level. Natalie and Sebastian share a brief kiss under the white roses, her hands still holding his lapels.
Panel 12: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle. Cassie, in front of the arch on the rose-bush side, lowers the gift box and stares with her lips parted, and Lauren, against the front-row chair on the hedge side, stiffens.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
